mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, it is 53 degrees and partly cloudy by the Verona Public Library under a full moon, and we are expecting an overnight low of 47 degrees with no rain.

The city has issued two important construction updates for Highway M. A closure is planned from October 5 to October 7 for final paving, and phase two of the utility and widening project is currently underway with traffic shifts occurring on the road.

There is a busy schedule ahead with live music tomorrow at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus yoga on September 28 and several trivia nights and a farmer's market coming up on September 29 and 30.
On September 5, local officers documented a strange incident where multiple vehicles were found with cheese slices on their windshields as part of a viral social media prank.
Today's flavor was OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The store is now closed for the evening, but you can look forward to the Turtle flavor when they open again tomorrow at 10 AM.
